subject.title: RFC: OpenClaw Mobile App Design Directions

question: Should this PR become the maintainer-sponsored mobile app design-direction RFC, and what must be confirmed before it can leave draft?
rationale: The branch is a draft product-direction venue, names OpenClaw maintainers as authors, and the repository README requires maintainer discussion plus acceptance before merge; automation cannot decide sponsorship or mobile direction.

options.title: Sponsor Through RFC Lifecycle
options.body: Confirm maintainer sponsorship, add the maintainer-discussion thread, keep the PR draft while directions are collected, and merge only after acceptance metadata is updated.

options.title: Keep Open For Collection
options.body: Leave this PR open as an exploratory collection point without accepting it yet, so contributors can add design directions while maintainers defer the merge decision.

options.title: Close If Unsponsored
options.body: If maintainers do not want this PR to be the mobile design venue, close it and direct contributors to the chosen discussion location.

recommendation.title: Sponsor Through RFC Lifecycle
recommendation.body: Confirm maintainer sponsorship, add the maintainer-discussion thread, keep the PR draft while directions are collected, and merge only after acceptance metadata is updated.

likelyOwner.reason: Best available owner from current repo history for the RFC lifecycle policy that controls when a draft RFC can merge.
